module_summary: Lemmings Moore FSM with walk/fall/dig/dead states and a saturating fall-duration counter that forces DEAD after landing from a long fall.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Seven-state controller: walk, fall, dig per direction plus terminal DEAD.

anchors.name: fall_counter
anchors.why: Saturating count of falling cycles; reaching 20 sends FSM to DEAD on landing.

anchors.name: ground
anchors.why: Highest-priority condition: absence forces falling, return ends fall.

anchors.name: dig
anchors.why: Starts digging from a walking state when ground present.

anchors.name: bump_left
anchors.why: Reverses walk-left to walk-right; lowest priority.

anchors.name: bump_right
anchors.why: Reverses walk-right to walk-left; lowest priority.

anchors.name: aaah
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from either falling state.

anchors.name: digging
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from either digging state.

groups.name: lemming_fsm
groups.description: Prioritized next-state logic (fall > dig > bump) and state register.

groups.name: fall_timer
groups.description: Counts falling cycles, saturates at 20, cleared otherwise.

groups.name: output_decode
groups.description: Decodes state into walk_left, walk_right, aaah, digging; all zero when dead.
